# Mr Md Zaker Ullah FRCS, Consultant Oncoplastic Breast Surgeon, London and Essex

> Consultant oncoplastic breast and general surgeon in London and Essex. Clinical Lead of the Breast Unit at Whipps Cross University Hospital, Barts Health NHS Trust. Private practice at The Harley Street Clinic, Nuffield Health at St Bartholomew's and Nuffield Health The Holly Hospital. GMC 4368515. Rated 5.0 out of 5 from 22 verified reviews on iWantGreatCare. Private secretary: 020 8936 1263.

## Treatments
- [Breast lumps and pain](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/benign-breast-conditions/): Examination, imaging and biopsy for a new breast symptom, usually at a single visit.
- [Breast cancer surgery](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-cancer-surgery/): Breast conserving surgery, therapeutic mammoplasty, mastectomy and lymph node surgery.
- [Breast reconstruction](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-reconstruction/): Immediate and delayed reconstruction using implants, your own tissue, fat grafting and nipple reconstruction.
- [Breast reduction](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-reduction/): Reduction mammoplasty for comfort and proportion, or to balance the breasts after cancer surgery.
- [Breast augmentation](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-augmentation/): Implant augmentation for size or shape, and to restore symmetry after cancer surgery.
- [Fat grafting](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/fat-grafting/): Using your own fat to refine shape after surgery, correct contour and soften scar tissue.
- [Gynaecomastia](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/gynaecomastia/): Specialist assessment of the male breast, and surgery for established gynaecomastia.
- [Hernia and gallbladder](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/general-laparoscopic-surgery/): Laparoscopic gallbladder removal, hernia repair and appendicectomy.
